comment: Real Uniswap router transactions fetched 2026-10-11 from public RPC nodes (eth_getTransactionByHash fields); see the explorer link for each. Entries whose tx starts with "synthetic-" are NOT real transactions: hand-built attack and edge cases (see their "synthetic" description), encoded by an independent ABI encoder and cross-checked against web3j in SwapReviewTest.

vectors.synthetic: SwapRouter02 multicall sending 0.5 ETH: exactInputSingle(WETH->DAI, 0.5 ETH paid from the value, min 1200 DAI, to the wallet); exactInputSingle(USDC->WETH, 1000 USDC from the wallet, min 0, to the router); unwrapWETH9(0). The unwrapped ETH is the zero-minimum output of the USDC swap, not unused input: the review must show 'You get at least 0 ETH' with the No-minimum DANGER.

Universal Router 2.0 sending 0.5 ETH: WRAP_ETH(router, 0.5 ETH); V3_SWAP_EXACT_IN(wallet, 0.5 WETH, min 1200 DAI, router pays); V3_SWAP_EXACT_IN(router, 1000 USDC, min 0, wallet pays); UNWRAP_WETH(wallet, 0). Same hidden zero-minimum swap as the SwapRouter02 vector: DANGER expected.
As ur-zero-min-weth-unwrapped-as-refund, but the zero-minimum WETH output is returned with SWEEP(WETH, wallet, 0) instead of unwrapped: DANGER expected.
Universal Router 2.0: 100 USDC -> WETH (min 0.0312, to the router), PAY_PORTION(WETH, fee collector, 500 bips = 5%), UNWRAP_WETH(wallet, 0.0296). A 'fee' above 3% is shown as OTHER ADDRESS (DANGER).
Universal Router 2.0: PAY_PORTION to the zero address (burns the fee): refused.
